name: Gene-Adaptive Multi-Mechanism Chromatin Stacking Ensemble
summary: We combine four complementary models via nested out-of-fold per-gene ridge stacking: an ATAC cluster-mean anchor, a cluster-residual MLP, a proximal 100kb cis-peak masked network, and a low-rank gene-embedding multitask network. All representations, clusters, early-stopped neural fits, and meta-weights are learned strictly inside outer training folds and scored against binomial-thinned RNA across three 3-fold seeds. Paired-bootstrap comparisons against technical, ceiling, and cluster-mean rulers at 5% FDR determine which genes are predicted beyond cell identity.
analysis_unit: single cell (individual nucleus from the single healthy PBMC donor)
preprocessing: Strictly inside each outer training split (and on all 7,288 development cells alone for the final refit), select top 80,000 and top 25,000 peaks by binary accessibility frequency, compute TF-IDF weights on binarised peaks, and fit 101-component truncated SVD dropping component 1 to retain 100 depth-orthogonal LSI components.

Fit k=20 ATAC baseline clusters (frozen development k) on outer-training LSI coordinates only and assign unseen inner, outer-validation, and held-out cells to nearest training centroids without refitting.

Compute depth-normalised promoter-and-distal gene activity across the 11,282 frozen in-scope genes, extract up to 15 proximal peaks within +/-100 kb of each gene start site from peak-to-gene annotations, and z-score log1p ATAC fragment depth using outer-training statistics.

Normalise outer-training raw RNA UMI counts via 10,000-count library scaling and log1p transformation with no smoothing; split each unseen outer-validation cell's raw UMIs via independent binomial thinning (p=0.5) per seed into log1p-normalised halves A (ceiling input) and B (scoring target), excluding held-out cells from all fitting and WNN labels from all model inputs and truth.

training.convergence_audit: Log epoch-wise training and 10% inner-validation MSE curves for all three neural members across OOF and full-split refits, confirm validation loss convergence before max_epochs, fit GCV-tuned per-gene ridge weights on unsmoothed OOF predictions, and refit all four members on 100% of outer-training cells.

validation.gene_claim_rule: Verify all comparators on known-answer checks first, then evaluate candidate, constituent members, ceiling, null, and floors on identical unseen outer-fold cells, identical thinned RNA half B, all 11,282 frozen genes, and identical zero-variance handling (r=0). Place genes whose ceiling fails the 95th percentile of the 1,000-shuffle cell-permutation null into Group 0 (unjudgeable). Require mean r to exceed floor_3_depth and floor_2_gene_activity and measure seed/fold spread against simple_reference. Among judgeable genes, test r(ensemble) > r(floor_1_cell_type) via 1,000 paired cell-bootstrap resamples, apply Benjamini-Hochberg across all 11,282 in-scope genes at 5% FDR to call Group 2 (reliably predicted beyond cell type), and place remaining judgeable genes in Group 1.

metrics: Per-gene Pearson correlation r against unsmoothed binomial-thinned log-normalised RNA (half B) and paired-bootstrap gain delta_r over floor_1_cell_type with two-sided empirical 95% confidence intervals for all 11,282 in-scope genes
Mean and median per-gene Pearson r plus across-seed and across-fold spread (mean +/- SD over 3 seeds x 3 folds) compared against simple_reference, single-member ablations, and floors 1-4
Counts and identities of genes assigned to unjudgeable, not-beyond-cell-type, and reliably-predicted-beyond-cell-type decision groups at 5% BH FDR
Ratio of achieved per-gene Pearson r to the RNA-to-RNA half-A-to-half-B noise ceiling across judgeable in-scope genes
Within-cluster Pearson r per gene across nested k=20 ATAC clusters and development-only descriptive WNN cell types (down to the 15-cell Plasma cluster) alongside pooled r
Empirical coverage and width of paired-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals across validation folds, plus learned per-gene ridge meta-weights across the four regulatory members
allowed_conclusions: Select strictly one of the four pre-specified conclusion options (unjudgeable due to noise, confounded by sequencing depth, no gene predicted beyond cell identity, or specific identified genes predicted beyond cell identity at 5% BH FDR accompanied by a finite 3124x11282 log-normalised held-out prediction matrix and 95% intervals), scoped exclusively to unseen granulocyte-depleted PBMCs from this single healthy donor under the same Multiome assay with no generalisation to other donors, tissues, conditions, granulocytes, or causal regulation.
rationale: No single inductive bias suits 11,282 genes facing 85% RNA zeros (D1) and strong cell-type baselines (D6). Per-gene out-of-fold ridge stacking lets noisy genes borrow low-rank module strength, dynamic genes combine proximal cis-peaks with rare-cluster-preserving residuals (D2), and static genes anchor on cluster means.
